messagesRoleLayout: single 'user' message; no 'system' and no 'assistant' message

maxOutputTokens_detail.note: openaiAdapter never puts max_tokens in the request body, so the Celeris server's own default (2048) governs. Long multi-line invoices (e.g. cases/invoice-06, 9 line items) can exceed 2048 completion tokens -> finish_reason 'length' -> truncated JSON -> INVALID_JSON_FORMAT. For the bake-off, raise the server default toward 8192 (contract max) or have Flowgenix pass maxOutputTokens through; record which you used.

requestTimeoutMs_detail.note: Flowgenix's axios call sets no timeout (PROJECT_LOG.md 5.9 risk 5) -> a slow local model can block the Agenda worker up to its 30-min lock. The Celeris server MUST enforce its own timeout and return HTTP 408.

schema_detail.note: callOptions for this scene do not include `schema`, so openaiAdapter's Ajv path (adapter maxRetries default 1) never runs. adapterRetriesOnSchemaFail is therefore 0 in practice. The middleware profile also sets schema:null. See schema/schema_notes.md.

jsonHandling.repairFn: backend/utils/jsonFixer.js -> validateAndFixJSON (strip code fences, close arrays, quote keys, drop trailing commas, quote bare values)
jsonHandling.onUnrecoverable: error code INVALID_JSON_FORMAT, upload marked failed

languagePolicy: Prompt forces detection + translation of any non-English field VALUES to English before returning JSON (aiConstants.js prefix line 6; openaiAdapter prefix line 88; invoice prompt IMPORTANT RULES). Goldens assume English output.
